# LibreOffice Impress GUI Interface Description

## System and Application Header

- **Operating System Taskbar**: Located at the top of the screen, showing system applications and status indicators.
  - **Activities Button**: On the far left.
  - **Application Icons**: Chrome, Thunderbird, Visual Studio Code, VLC Media Player, LibreOffice Writer, LibreOffice Calc, LibreOffice Impress, GIMP, and others.
  - **System Indicators**: Clock showing "Oct 23 17:05", notification bell, volume control, and system menu.

- **Application Title Bar**: Displays the document name and application title.
  - **Document Name**: "ASIST-Strategic-Plan-Town-Hall.pptx - LibreOffice Impress"
  - **Application Title**: "LibreOffice Impress"

## Menu Bar

- **Main Menu Options**: From left to right: File, Edit, View, Insert, Format, Slide, Slide Show, Tools, Window, Help.
  - **Insert Menu**: Currently open, displaying a dropdown list of insertion options.
    - **Insert Options**:
      - Image...
      - Audio or Video...
      - Chart...
      - Table...
      - Media
      - Object
      - Shape
      - Snap Guide...
      - Text Box
      - Comment (Ctrl+Alt+C)
      - Floating Frame...
      - Fontwork...
      - Hyperlink...
      - Special Character...
      - Formatting Mark
      - Slide Number
      - Field
      - Header and Footer...
      - Form Control

## Toolbar

- **Main Toolbar**: Located directly below the menu bar, containing various icons for common actions.
  - **File Operations**: New, Open, Save, Save As, Print.
  - **Editing Tools**: Cut, Copy, Paste, Undo, Redo.
  - **View Tools**: Zoom In, Zoom Out, Fit to Window.
  - **Insertion Tools**: Insert Image, Insert Audio/Video, Insert Chart, Insert Table, Insert Media, Insert Object, Insert Shape.
  - **Formatting Tools**: Font style, font size, bold, italic, underline, text color, alignment, bullet points, numbering.
  - **Slide Tools**: Slide layout, slide transition, slide animation, slide master.
  - **Other Tools**: Find, Replace, Spell Check, Accessibility, Drawing Tools.

## Slide Navigation Panel

- **Slide Thumbnails**: Located on the left side of the screen, showing thumbnails of all slides in the presentation.
  - **Slide 1**: Title slide with "ASIST STRATEGIC PLANNING TOWN HALL MEETING".
  - **Slide 2**: Blank slide with placeholder text.
  - **Slide 3**: Currently selected slide, titled "AGENDA" with bullet points.
  - **Slide 4**: Blank slide with placeholder text.
  - **Slide 5**: Title "BACKGROUND".
  - **Slide 6**: Title "WHY STRATEGIC PLANNING?" with content.
  - **Slide 7**: Title "HOW DID WE GET HERE?" with content.
  - **Slide 8**: Title "WHAT DO WE NEED FROM YOU?" with content.
  - **Slide 9**: Title "DISCUSSING THE STRATEGIC PLAN" with content.
  - **Slide 10**: Placeholder for additional content.

## Slide Content Area

- **Current Slide**: Slide 3, titled "AGENDA".
  - **Content**: Placeholder text for agenda items.
  - **Text Boxes**: Two text boxes with placeholder text "Click to add Text" and "Click to add Title".
  - **Icons**: Icons for inserting images, charts, and other media.
  - **Footer**: Contains the "asis&t" logo and the text "Association for Information Science and Technology".

## Properties Panel

- **Properties Panel**: Located on the right side of the screen, showing properties of the selected slide.
  - **Slide Properties**:
    - **Format**: Widescreen
    - **Orientation**: Landscape
    - **Background**: None
    - **Master Slide**: Title Slide
    - **Master Background**: Checked
    - **Master Objects**: Checked
    - **Master View**: Button available
  - **Layouts**: Grid of layout options, with one layout selected (highlighted in orange).

## Status Bar

- **Status Bar**: Located at the bottom of the screen, showing various status indicators.
  - **Slide Number**: "Slide 3 of 20"
  - **Title Slide**: Indicates the current slide type.
  - **Coordinates**: "-0.52 / -1.87" and "0.00 x 0.00"
  - **Language**: "English (USA)"
  - **Zoom Level**: "92%" with zoom controls.

## Additional UI Elements

- **Floating Buttons**: Located in the top right corner of the screen.
  - **Close
